title: 第48章 鲤鱼第47章 亲自到达蛮荒
content_zh:
通道深处，天光已完全消失，
那种暗红色的穹顶光泽在被他们抛在身后的世界尽头渐渐熄灭。
君澜抱着树妖跟在谢怜身后，
脚下的地面已经从碎石变成了某种光滑的、泛着微光的质地，
像被水流打磨了千百年的卵石层，踩上去有一种奇异的温润感。
树妖蜷在他怀里，呼吸平稳了许多，暗红色的眼睛半睁半闭，
那层从后颈裂缝中涌出的暗红光泽已经褪尽，
重新变回浅褐色的疤痕。
经过他肩膀那道被地蟒尾巴戳中的伤处，衣料已经裂开，
露出底下泛青的皮肤。皮下那些木质纹理正在缓慢地重新排列，
像被揉皱的纸再重新展平。
谢怜走在前面，背对着他，脚步稳健，根须从靴底渗出，
贴着光滑的软石面向前蔓延，探路。他的脊背绷得很直，
肩膀微微向右侧偏着，每一步落地都带着某种小心。
“你在探路吗？”君澜问。
他的声音从前方传来，闷闷的。
通道正在变窄，前面的空间在收束。
君澜这才注意到，两侧的岩壁确实在缓慢地向内合拢。
起初不易察觉，但走得越深，那收束的幅度便越明显。
起初还能容两人并肩，后来就只能一前一后侧身通过，

再到后来，连侧身都显得勉强。
他必须微微弓着背，
让树妖的头紧贴着胸口才能挤过去。
空气中原本那种焦糊的气味渐渐淡了，
取而代之的是一种陈旧的、带着矿物和潮湿泥土的混合气息。
他想起很多年前，他站在联合国河道末端的城墙裂缝前，闻到过类似的气味。
那是被封闭了很久很久的空间，终于被打开一条缝隙时泄露出来的第一口气息。
谢怜停了下来。
君澜差点撞上他的后背，他稳住脚步，从他肩侧探出头去。
前方的通道在此处骤然收束成一道极窄的缝隙，只容一个人侧身挤过。
缝隙边缘的岩石表面泛着一层暗沉的金属光泽，
像被高温融化过又重新凝固的矿石。
缝隙后方隐约透出一种不同于暗红色天光的光线，是柔和的，泛着金色的光。
“这后面是什么？”君澜问。
谢怜侧耳听了一会儿，水声很轻，像在地下很深处流动。
“还有风。”
“风？”君澜微微皱眉。
蛮荒之地没有风，那是他们在这片灰白色大地上度过的日子中唯一不动的东西。
“有风，”谢怜笃定地说道，
“而且不像蛮荒的风，这风里有草木的气味。”

君澜将树妖往怀里紧了紧，树妖发出含混的闷意，换了个姿势，
content_en:
Deep in the passage, the skylight has completely disappeared,
The dark red dome's luster gradually extinguished at the end of the world they left behind.
Jun Lan hugged the tree demon and followed behind Xie Lian.
The ground beneath my feet had changed from gravel to some kind of smooth, shimmering texture.
It looks like a layer of pebbles that has been polished by water for thousands of years. It feels strangely moist when you step on it.
The dryad curled up in his arms, breathing much calmer, its dark red eyes half-opened and half-closed.
The dark red luster that emerged from the crack on the back of the neck has faded away.
The scars returned to light brown.
After passing the wound on his shoulder where he was stabbed by the python's tail, the material of his clothes had torn.
Revealing the bluish skin underneath. The wooden textures under the skin are slowly rearranging,
Like crumpled paper flattened again.
Xie Lian walked in front, with her back to him, her steps steady, roots seeping out from the soles of her boots,
Spreading forward against the smooth soft stone, exploring the path. His back was straight,
The shoulders are slightly tilted to the right, and every step is taken with some caution.
"Are you exploring the road?" Jun Lan asked.
His voice came from the front, muffled.
The passage is narrowing and the space in front is closing.
Only then did Jun Lan notice that the rock walls on both sides were indeed slowly closing inward.
It's not easy to notice at first, but the deeper you go, the more obvious the contraction becomes.
At first it was possible for two people to pass side by side, but later they could only pass side by side, one behind the other.
Later, even turning sideways seemed forced.
He must arch his back slightly,
Keep the dryad's head close to its chest to squeeze through.
The original burnt smell in the air gradually faded away.
Instead there's an old, mineral and damp earthy mix.
He remembered that many years ago, he had smelled a similar smell while standing in front of the crack in the city wall at the end of the United Nations River Channel.
That was the first breath that leaked out when a gap was finally opened in a space that had been sealed for a long time.
Thanks for stopping.
Jun Lan almost bumped into his back, but he steadied his steps and stuck his head out from his shoulder.
The passage ahead suddenly narrowed into an extremely narrow gap, allowing only one person to squeeze through sideways.
The rock surface at the edge of the gap has a dull metallic luster.
Like ore that has been melted by high temperatures and then solidified again.
A kind of light that was different from the dark red skylight was faintly revealed from behind the gap. It was soft and glowing with golden light.
"What's behind this?" Jun Lan asked.
Xie Lian listened for a while. The sound of water was very soft, as if it was flowing deep underground.
"There's still wind."
"Wind?" Jun Lan frowned slightly.
There was no wind in the wild land, and it was the only thing that didn't move during the days they spent in this gray-white land.
"It's windy," Xie Lian said firmly,
"And unlike the wild wind, this wind has the smell of vegetation."
Jun Lan hugged the dryad tightly. The dryad let out a vague sigh and changed its posture.
